Avatar loading after download is complete has been reduced to below one second in most cases in VRChat 2019.3.1, which is now in Open Beta.

This is, of course, assuming the download completes successfully with no issues, and the avatar is not exceedingly complex/badly performing/etc.

Avatar validation time greatly mitigated as of 2019.3.1.

If the second issue "avatars with some animations cause performance issues" is still present (and not addressed in another post) please open a new Feedback post.
